practical_selection_policy: For each model/PLE/sequence, show the highest observed rate among tested recipe representatives after choosing the longer confirmation within each exact recipe. This is a whole-configuration overview, not an isolated PLE effect or a claim of the fastest possible training.

controller_confirmed_test_executions.evidence: Counts and durations from the controller's observed final pytest results. Detailed GPU8 case evidence is independently validated from the canonical receipt; historical diagnostic runs are separate.

scope: Synthetic complete-step throughput; no corpus packing, evaluation, checkpoint saving, convergence or language-quality measurement.
precision_scope: GPU AdamW8bit with BF16 stochastic rounding, BF16 parameter/gradient storage except 21,672 FP32 KDA decay-gate elements; no FP32 master weights or offloaded moments. Optional NVFP4/SR4 covers QKV, attention output and FFN projections, not KDA recurrence/gates, embeddings, PLE, head or norms.
